title: Design System: Awesome AI for Industrial Ecology

headline.purpose: Every page title, under the running head.

title.purpose: h2, opened by a 1px ink rule above.

body.purpose: Markdown prose at a 68ch measure. All three faces are self-hosted with font-display: optional; Archivo and Source Serif are preloaded in Head.astro.

label.purpose: Running heads, sidebar, chips, tags, buttons, table cells.

caption.purpose: Figure and table captions and source lines, including the Table N.N title and source of Markdown tables.

code.purpose: Code only. Martian Mono loads with font-display: optional.

motion.name: band-focus
motion.purpose: Flow plate bands rising and receding on hover or focus.

motion.name: caret
motion.purpose: Facet trigger and application entry carets rotating on open.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All three transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Below: running head drops its right part; flow labels enlarge to 32 user units; Path steps stack; grid heads use short field names.

breakpoints.name: chapter-strip
breakpoints.purpose: At and above: five-column chapter index; square embeds.

breakpoints.name: cover
breakpoints.purpose: At and above: two-column cover (6fr title, 7fr Fig. 1); flow labels 19 user units.

components.css: .ds-grid { font-family: var(--sl-font, 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif); color: var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); } .ds-grid-title { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-grid-title b { margin-right: 0.5rem; } .ds-grid table { border-collapse: collapse; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border-top: 2px solid var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); } .ds-grid th, .ds-grid td { padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sl-color-hairline, #2c3038); text-align: center; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-grid thead th { font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 82%; border-bottom-color: var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); } .ds-grid tbody th { text-align: left; font-weight: 650; } .ds-grid td > a { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 2.75rem; height: 1.75rem; font-weight: 750; text-decoration: none; color: var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); } .ds-grid td[data-n='1'] > a { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-1, #8eaaff) 30%, transparent); } .ds-grid td[data-n='2'] > a { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-1, #8eaaff) 45%, transparent); } .ds-grid td[data-n='3'] > a { background: var(--ink-1, #8eaaff); color: var(--on-ink, #121419); } .ds-grid td[data-n='0']::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 2.75rem; height: 1.75rem; border: 1px dashed var(--sl-color-gray-4, #5f656e); vertical-align: middle; } .ds-grid td a:hover, .ds-grid td a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); } .ds-grid-src { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--sl-color-gray-3, #969ca5); }

components.css: .ds-flow { margin: 0; } .ds-flow svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .ds-flow text { font-family: var(--sl-font, 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 650; font-stretch: 82%; word-spacing: 0.1em; fill: var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); } .ds-flow .ds-n { font-weight: 500; fill: var(--sl-color-gray-3, #969ca5); } .ds-band { fill: var(--field); fill-opacity: var(--band-opacity, 0.55); transition: fill-opacity 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bands:has(a:is(:hover, :focus-visible)) .ds-band { fill-opacity: 0.12; } .ds-bands a:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .ds-band { fill-opacity: 0.9; } .ds-flow a:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-flow a:focus-visible .ds-band { stroke: var(--sl-color-text-accent, #8eaaff); stroke-width: 3; paint-order: stroke; } .ds-flow figcaption { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.25rem 1.5rem; margin-top: 0.75rem; padding-top: 0.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--sl-color-hairline, #2c3038); font-family: var(--sl-font, 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--sl-color-gray-2, #bcc1c8); } .ds-flow figcaption b { color: var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); margin-right: 0.25rem; } .ds-src { color: var(--sl-color-gray-3, #969ca5); } @media (max-width: 40rem) { .ds-flow text { font-size: 32px; } } @media (min-width: 64rem) { .ds-flow text { font-size: 19px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-band { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-entry { padding: 0.85rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sl-color-hairline, #2c3038); } .ds-entry summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 0.2rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-entry summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-entry summary::after { content: ''; grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; align-self: center; width: 0.45rem; height: 0.45rem; border: solid var(--sl-color-gray-3, #969ca5); border-width: 0 1.5px 1.5px 0; transform: rotate(45deg); transition: transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-entry details[open] > summary::after { transform: rotate(-135deg); } .ds-entry-name { font-family: var(--sl-font, 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 90%; font-size: 1.0625rem; } .ds-entry summary:hover .ds-entry-name { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-entry-maturity { grid-column: 1; max-width: 68ch; font-family: var(--font-read, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', Georgia, serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--sl-color-gray-2, #bcc1c8); } .ds-entry-desc { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0.6rem 0 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-read, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', Georgia, serif); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--sl-color-gray-1, #dcdfe3); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-entry summary::after { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-path { margin: 0; } .ds-path ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 1.25rem; } @media (min-width: 40rem) { .ds-path ol { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2.5rem; } .ds-path li + li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -0.55rem; left: -2.1rem; width: 0.8rem; height: 0.8rem; border: solid var(--sl-color-gray-3, #969ca5); border-width: 2px 2px 0 0; transform: rotate(45deg); } } .ds-path li { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; align-content: start; padding-top: 0.6rem; border-top: 3px solid var(--chapter-ink); } .ds-path a { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; color: var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); text-decoration: none; } .ds-path-step { font-family: var(--sl-font, 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 85%; color: var(--sl-color-gray-3, #969ca5); } .ds-path-verb { font-family: var(--sl-font, 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 760; font-stretch: 80%; line-height: 1.1; word-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-path a:hover .ds-path-verb { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--chapter-ink); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-path-fact { font-family: var(--font-read, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', Georgia, serif); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--sl-color-gray-2, #bcc1c8); } .ds-path figcaption { margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: 0.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--sl-color-hairline, #2c3038); font-family: var(--sl-font, 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--sl-color-gray-2, #bcc1c8); } .ds-path figcaption b { margin-right: 0.25rem; color: var(--sl-color-white, #f1f2f4); }

narrative.overview:
The site is set like a statistical yearbook for industrial ecology. Each chapter has a number and a printing ink. A running head sits above every page title. Claims appear as numbered tables and figures, each with a source line. The cover figure is a material-flow (Sankey) plate, the field's own graphic: it shows the literature flowing from IE field to AI technique, and every band links to the filtered papers.

The page is paper and ink. The theme follows the reader's system setting. Dark is a blue-black stock with near-white ink; light is a cool white stock with near-black ink. Five printing inks (cobalt, vermilion, olive, ochre, plum) carry all colour, and each ink has two jobs: it marks a chapter, and four of them also mark an IE field. Everything else is grey. Corners are square, depth comes from rules rather than shadows, and type is narrow Archivo for anything that labels or structures and Source Serif 4 for anything to be read.

Density is that of a reference work: tight ruled tables, compact chips, reading text at a 68ch measure. The docs-site hero with a button pair and a card grid is rejected. The cover leads with the title, a lede, one primary action beside a text link, and Fig. 1.
keyCharacteristics: Numbered chapters, each with its own ink, repeated on sidebar tabs, running heads and the home chapter index.
Numbered figures and tables with a caption and a "Source:" line naming the data file.
Square corners everywhere, including Starlight's own controls.
Hairline and ink rules for structure; no cards, no drop shadows at rest.
Narrow sans for structure, serif for reading, mono only for code.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: An ink means a chapter or an IE field, and the pairing is fixed: cobalt = 1 Map = LCA, vermilion = 2 Literature = EoL, olive = 3 Practice = MFA, ochre = 4 Tools = urban mining, plum = 5 Demos. Never use an ink for decoration, and never give a new field or chapter an ink already taken by a different meaning.

rules.name: The Swatch Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Outside the cover plate, an IE field shows its ink as a small square swatch (0.55 to 0.75rem) beside its label, never as a filled chip or coloured text.

rules.name: The One Hue Count Rule
rules.body: Count shading on a grid uses one ink at stepped strength (30%, 45%, solid for 3 and more). An empty cell is a dashed outline, not a pale fill.

rules.name: The Narrow For Structure Rule
rules.body: Anything that names, numbers or navigates is Archivo set narrow (font-stretch 72 to 90%). Anything a reader reads through is Source Serif 4. Interactive islands (.not-content) set their own text in Archivo.

rules.name: The Open Space Rule
rules.body: Narrow widths shrink the space glyph, so narrow headings, running heads, chapter titles, sidebar labels and figure text take word-spacing: 0.1em.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Tables, counts, meta lines and scores use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat on the stock and are separated by rules. No shadows; a panel that opens pushes the content down rather than covering it.

rules.name: The Dashes Carry Meaning Rule
rules.body: A dashed outline marks a gap (the "Wanted" tag, an empty map cell) or sets the content-type tag apart from topic tags. Don't use dashes as decoration.

dos: Do number every figure and table ("Fig. 1", "Table 1.1") and give it a caption and a "Source:" line naming the data file.
Do take colour only from the five inks and the grey ramp, following the Two Jobs Rule.
Do keep every corner square (0px), including on Starlight components you restyle.
Do separate content with rules and hairlines; use the 2px ink rule for heads and table tops.
Do set structure in narrow Archivo and reading text in Source Serif 4 at a 68ch measure.
Do mark gaps with the dashed "Wanted" tag or a dashed empty cell.
Do check every new ink use against 4.5:1 on its theme's ground, in both themes.
donts: Don't build a docs-site hero with a button pair and a card grid.
Don't round corners or add drop shadows, and don't float a panel over content.
Don't use an ink for decoration, or reuse an ink for a meaning other than its chapter and field.
Don't fill an IE-field chip or set field-coloured text; use the square swatch.
Don't use dashed borders as decoration; they mean a gap or a content type.
